Premium cloth seating and a spacious interior create an inviting atmosphere for daily commutes or weekend journeys.  Technology integration enhances your driving experience seamlessly. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system with a 6-speaker audio setup ensures quality sound. An exterior parking camera rear simplifies maneuvering, and OnStar emergency communication services provide added peace of mind.  Safety remains a priority on this Malibu. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbag, and overhead airbag protection surround occupants. Four-wheel disc brakes with brake assist, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to maintain vehicle control. The low tire pressure warning system alerts you to maintenance needs before they become problems. Whether you're dealing with snow on Woodward Avenue or mud on a camping trip in the Upper Peninsula, the Grand Cherokee L is built to keep you moving. The Quadra-Trac system gives you confidence in slippery conditions without requiring you to think twice about it.Jeep Grand Cherokee L Features and InteriorAltitude Trim HighlightsThe Altitude trim takes the Grand Cherokee L's already-solid base and adds a blacked-out aesthetic that sets it apart from standard trims. This is one sharp SUV, offering an outstanding combination of sporty styling, premium comfort, modern technology, and everyday practicality. Equipped with the desirable R-Line appearance package, this Atlas Cross Sport features aggressive exterior styling, upgraded wheels, and distinctive R-Line accents that really set it apart from an ordinary SUV. Even better, this vehicle comes with an excellent documented service history, with maintenance records on file through Volkswagen! Under the hood is Volkswagen's powerful 3.6L V6 engine producing 276 horsepower and 266 lb-ft of torque, paired with a smooth 8-speed automatic transmission. This combination delivers strong acceleration, excellent highway performance, and the smooth driving characteristics Volkswagen is known for. With front-wheel drive and an estimated 18 MPG city and 23 MPG highway, this Atlas Cross Sport offers a great balance of V6 performance and everyday usability. The vehicle is also equipped with towing equipment, adding additional versatility for weekend adventures and recreational use! One of the biggest highlights of this particular Atlas Cross Sport is its desirable R-Line styling package! The R-Line gives this SUV a much sportier, more aggressive appearance with unique R-Line front and rear bumpers, distinctive R-Line exterior badging, upgraded 20-inch alloy wheels, and sporty exterior accents. The beautiful white paint contrasts perfectly with the darker trim and bold styling, creating an exceptionally sharp appearance. The sleek, coupe-inspired roofline and wide stance make the Atlas Cross Sport one of the most attractive SUVs in Volkswagen's lineup! Step inside and you'll find a beautifully designed Titan Black interior featuring comfortable leatherette seating, heated front seats, and premium interior appointments throughout. The spacious front seats provide excellent comfort for daily driving, while the generous rear seating area offers outstanding legroom for passengers. Unlike the traditional three-row Atlas, the Atlas Cross Sport features a spacious two-row, five-passenger configuration with an exceptionally large cargo area. The rear seats fold down to provide even more room for luggage, groceries, sports equipment, and everyday necessities. Technology is another major selling point! This Atlas Cross Sport features Volkswagen's touchscreen infotainment system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing you to connect your smartphone for navigation, music, phone calls, and messages. Additional conveniences include Bluetooth connectivity, steering wheel-mounted controls, dual-zone automatic climate control, rear passenger air vents, and convenient USB charging ports. The SE with Technology trim also provides desirable upgrades such as remote engine start, keyless access with push-button start, and a power-operated rear liftgate. Safety is equally impressive with Volkswagen's advanced driver-assistance technology! This Atlas Cross Sport features adaptive cruise control, allowing the vehicle to help maintain a selected following distance from traffic ahead. Additional safety features include Forward Collision Warning with Autonomous Emergency Braking, Blind Spot Monitoring, Rear Traffic Alert, and a rearview backup camera. Front and rear parking sensors provide additional convenience when maneuvering in tighter spaces. With its gorgeous white exterior, sporty R-Line appearance package, powerful 3.6L V6 engine, heated front seats, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, adaptive cruise control, towing equipment, and excellent Volkswagen-documented service history, this 2021 Atlas Cross Sport is an outstanding SUV! If you're looking for something that combines bold styling, a spacious interior, modern technology, and impressive everyday versatility, this Volkswagen is an excellent choice! What this vehicle includes:               Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. description: If you're searching for a 2027 Mercedes-AMG G 63 for sale in Warren, Michigan, your search ends here. Empire Auto Collection, located in Warren in Macomb County, has just taken in one of the most iconic and capable luxury SUVs ever built  and with under 2,000 miles on the odometer, this is essentially a brand-new AMG G 63 at a fraction of the wait. Grey exterior, a thunderous twin-turbo V8, and full AMG Sport Utility presence make this one of the most compelling vehicles available in southeast Michigan right now.About This 2027 Mercedes-AMG G 63 Sport UtilityWith only 1,978 miles, this 2027 Mercedes-AMG G 63 is as close to factory-fresh as it gets on the pre-owned market. The grey exterior gives it a refined, stealthy look that stands apart from the more common white and black builds you see on the road. As a 2027 model year, this G 63 represents the latest iteration of Mercedes-AMG's engineering and refinement cycle, meaning you're getting the most current technology, safety systems, and interior appointments available in this generation. Whether you're buying for the prestige, the performance, or the unmatched road presence, this SUV delivers on every level.2027 Mercedes-AMG G 63 Performance and EngineTwin-Turbo V8 PowerUnder the hood sits a handcrafted 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 engine  AMG's legendary "hot inside V8" configuration  producing 577 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque in standard G 63 trim. This engine propels the G 63 from zero to sixty in around four seconds, a number that seems impossible for a vehicle built on a body-on-frame platform that dates back to the 1970s. The power delivery is immediate, authoritative, and addictive.AMG SPEEDSHIFT TCT 9-Speed TransmissionPaired to that V8 is AMG's 9G-TRONIC nine-speed automatic transmission with SPEEDSHIFT TCT technology. This unit offers lightning-fast gear changes in Sport and Sport+ modes, seamless cruising comfort in Normal mode, and full manual control via the AMG steering wheel paddles. The result is a drivetrain that feels equally at home on a Monday morning commute and a weekend canyon run.AWD and AMG-Tuned DynamicsAll-wheel drive comes standard, and in the G 63 it's paired with three locking differentials  a carry-over from the G-Wagen's military roots that makes this the most off-road capable AMG vehicle in the lineup. Combined with AMG-tuned air suspension and electronically controlled dampers, the ride quality is far more composed on pavement than the boxy exterior suggests.Mercedes-AMG G 63 Features and InteriorAMG Sport Utility AppointmentsThe G 63 Sport Utility trim brings a level of interior luxury that rivals anything in the Mercedes-Benz S-Class lineup. Expect AMG-exclusive Nappa leather upholstery, a redesigned widescreen MBUX cockpit display, AMG Performance steering wheel with touch-sensitive controls, ambient lighting with dozens of color options, and the signature round dashboard vents finished in chrome. The rear seat experience is equally impressive, with generous legroom and the kind of materials you'd expect in a six-figure vehicle.Technology and Driver AssistanceThe 2027 G 63 comes equipped with Mercedes' latest MBUX infotainment system, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, a Burmester surround sound system, heads-up display, and a full suite of AMG-specific drive modes selectable from the AMG Dynamic Select dial. Driver assistance features include active brake assist, blind-spot monitoring, lane-keeping assist, and adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go functionality.Mercedes-AMG G 63 Reliability and OwnershipThe G-Class platform has one of the most proven track records in the automotive world  it has been in continuous production since 1979 and is engineered to military-grade durability standards. The AMG G 63 specifically benefits from AMG's "one man, one engine" hand-assembly philosophy, where a single technician builds the entire V8 unit and signs a plaque that goes on the engine cover. Owners consistently report that with proper maintenance  regular oil changes using the correct synthetic specification, fluid checks, and brake inspections  the G 63 proves to be a remarkably reliable vehicle despite its performance pedigree. At just under 2,000 miles, this example has experienced virtually no wear, and all factory warranties remain in their strongest window.Why Buy From Empire Auto Collection in Warren, MichiganEmpire Auto Collection is Warren's destination for premium and exotic pre-owned vehicles. Located in Warren in Macomb County, the dealership has built a reputation across southeast Michigan for sourcing low-mileage, high-quality luxury inventory that buyers simply can't find at traditional franchise stores. The team at Empire Auto Collection understands that a purchase at this level is a significant decision, and they approach every customer relationship with transparency, patience, and genuine expertise. When you visit the showroom, you're not going to be rushed or pressured  you're going to be given the information and the time you need to feel completely confident in your purchase.Financing a Used Mercedes-AMG G 63 Near WarrenEmpire Auto Collection works with a broad network of lenders experienced in financing luxury and exotic vehicles, which means they can structure deals for buyers across a wide range of credit profiles. Whether you have excellent credit and are looking for the most competitive rate available, or you're in a more complex credit situation and need a lender who specializes in high-value vehicles, the finance team here has the relationships to make it happen. See the current price listed on this page, and contact Empire Auto Collection directly to get pre-qualified and discuss your options before you even step foot in the showroom.Frequently Asked QuestionsIs the 2027 Mercedes-AMG G 63 a good buy?Yes  the 2027 G 63 is considered the pinnacle of the G-Class lineup and one of the most capable, prestigious, and exciting luxury SUVs in the world. It combines genuine off-road ability with AMG supercar performance and S-Class interior quality. A 2027 model with under 2,000 miles represents exceptional value compared to ordering a new one and waiting months for delivery.How many miles is too many on a used Mercedes-AMG G 63?The G-Class platform is extraordinarily durable, and well-maintained examples regularly surpass 150,000 to 200,000 miles. For a performance-oriented buyer, anything under 30,000 miles is generally considered very low, and a G 63 with fewer than 2,000 miles is as close to new as a used vehicle can be.What does the AMG G 63 Sport Utility trim include?The AMG G 63 Sport Utility designation indicates the full AMG factory performance package  not an aftermarket conversion. This means the handbuilt 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8, AMG SPEEDSHIFT 9-speed transmission, three locking differentials, AMG interior appointments, and the complete AMG suite of drive modes and performance electronics come standard from the factory.Does the G 63 hold its value?The Mercedes-AMG G 63 is one of the strongest-depreciating luxury SUVs in automotive history in the positive sense  it holds its value exceptionally well compared to almost every competitor. Low-mileage examples like this 2027 model consistently command strong resale prices because demand for genuine G-Wagen product consistently outpaces supply.Is AWD standard on the Mercedes-AMG G 63?Yes. The G 63 comes standard with permanent all-wheel drive combined with three locking differentials  front, center, and rear  making it one of the most capable AWD systems available in any production vehicle, luxury or otherwise.Serving Warren and Surrounding AreasEmpire Auto Collection proudly serves buyers throughout Warren and the greater Macomb County area, including Sterling Heights, Shelby Township, Utica, Clinton Township, and St. Clair Shores. Buyers also make the short drive from Oakland County communities like Troy, Royal Oak, and Bloomfield Hills. If you're coming from further out  Grosse Pointe, Roseville, or anywhere across the Metro Detroit region  Warren is centrally located and easy to reach via I-696 or M-53. No matter where you're coming from in southeast Michigan, this G 63 is worth the drive.Contact Empire Auto Collection TodayReady to experience the 2027 Mercedes-AMG G 63 in person? Call Empire Auto Collection at (586) 662-2222 to speak with a team member, confirm availability, and schedule your private test drive. This is a one-of-a-kind opportunity to own an essentially new G 63 without the new-car wait  and at Empire Auto Collection in Warren, Michigan, the process is straightforward, professional, and built around you. Don't let this one get away.
